# SportSphere

> SportSphere is a sports-first social platform connecting fans, players, teams, leagues, and communities.

SportSphere helps users follow scores, share posts, discover players, and engage with sports communities.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://sportssphere.fun/): Main SportSphere experience
- [Players](https://sportssphere.fun/players): Public player directory
- [Leaderboard](https://sportssphere.fun/leaderboard): Public rankings
- [Privacy Policy](https://sportssphere.fun/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://sportssphere.fun/terms): Terms of service

## Optional

- [Player demo](https://sportssphere.fun/player-demo): Public player profile demo

## Contact

Website: https://sportssphere.fun/
